name: Theriancore
summary: Theriancore is an internet aesthetic and DIY art style originating from the modern therian and alterhuman communities.
description: Theriancore is an internet aesthetic and DIY art style originating from the modern therian and alterhuman communities. Unlike the internal psychological or spiritual identity of therianthropy itself, Theriancore specifically refers to the visual style and other forms of fashion used by its practitioners online. The aesthetic heavily utilizes digital "spirit edits," handcrafted animal masks, and low-angle nature videography to visually simulate a non-human feral perspective.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Visual escapism, nature appreciation, DIY crafting, digital anonymity

visualDNA.colour: Muted earth tones (moss green, charcoal, rust, brown, cream), stark white (for digital line art)
